name: TBETS-M-UCT (heterogeneous MCTS grown with greedy children and mutated siblings)
description: heterogeneous-mcts's tree of atomic actions (purchase, combat move, non-combat move of every player), grown as tbets-segmented: a node's first child is its greedy action, and each expansion adds either the leaf's greedy child (TBETS_GREEDY_PCT %) or a mutation of the leaf (another action of its parent's decision) as a sibling.
